verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a state tax authority whose filings and taxpayer records are held by the state agency under its own jurisdiction. A user-selectable storage region or residency option does not fit this kind of product, so the axis is a category error rather than an unevidenced capability. Nothing in the evidence (Webfile, eSystems, open-data rails) suggests any residency choice exists that would make the axis apply.
